headline: Kim Yong-beom: 'There is still much to do, but now it's the next person's turn… I am proud of the results'
summary: Kim Yong-beom, the first policy chief of the Lee Jae-myung government who oversaw economic and industrial policy, has stepped down after 15 months. He said there is still much to be done.
why: The policy chief coordinates economic and industrial policy in South Korea, so leadership changes can affect policy direction for major exporters.
